LanguageData.TM_Bridge_ApothecaryAntitoxin.label: Antitoxin
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_ApothecaryGoldenHour.label: Golden Hour kit
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_ApothecaryAntitoxin.descriptio: Reduce food poisoning by 20% on contact. Once per illness. Costs 20% of maximum herbs. Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_ApothecaryGoldenHour.descripti: Stand still and treat up to four allies within eight cells for 20 seconds. Heal up to 20 points of recent wounds per ally and halve bleeding. Costs 60% herbs and four herbal medicines carried or within reach. Cooldown two days.
